The selected model mix used 9 hw_mul, 4 hw_mul_damped, 1 hw_add, 1 hw_add_damped, and 1 seasonal_naive across 16 series.

limitations.text: Results rely on a single June 2025 vintage and cover only four states and four industries, not all Australian retail.
